cat-and-granny.title: Play Cat and Granny - A Chaotic Cat Adventure Game
cat-and-granny.slogan: Outsmart the Black Cat and Cause Havoc!
cat-and-granny.description: Cat and Granny is a chaotic first-person action game where you play as a clever orange cat. Your mission is to outsmart the new black cat that Granny brought home! Knock over flower pots, scatter objects, and scratch up furniture—all while making Granny believe the black cat is to blame. Experience the fun and mischief in Cat and Granny today!
